create_leafnode: create a LeafNode with a depth, composite rules, and optional prediction value
build_splitnode: build a SplitNode with left and right child nodes and composite split rules
test_data_in_node: test the BaseNode data_in_node method to condition covariate and response tensors on composite rules
refactor_leafnode_grow: refactor the LeafNode grow_node static method to convert a leaf into a SplitNode with new children
review_splitnode_prune: review the SplitNode prune_node static method to convert a prunable split node back into a LeafNode
